authorization: Requires parent-relayed Phase-10 acceptance plus an exact clean candidate and a genuine previous release binary. This plan never authorizes execution; release_gate keeps the install matrix NOT_RUN until a real digest-bound run produces evidence.

candidate_rules.digest_binding: candidate and previous SHA-256 recorded before the first scenario, after each install, and after the matrix

environment.platform: native Linux first; WSL2 is a separate acceptance lane
environment.network_isolation: bubblewrap unshared network for install and TUI smoke
environment.state_root: repository-contained temporary root; never the invoking user's home

steps: verify candidate SHA-256 against the pinned value
run install --binary <candidate> --sha256 <pinned candidate SHA-256> --no-modify-path into the isolated state root; require host ELF architecture match and staged digest recheck
assert horizoncode and hzcode both resolve to the same installed entrypoint
assert the installed executable digest equals the candidate digest
launch the installed binary inside the network-isolated home
wait up to the bounded 10s first-frame window and drain one settled frame
SIGKILL and wait the bounded reap window before reporting leftover descendants
install the genuine previous release binary and record its digest
install the exact candidate over it
assert both command names activate the candidate and the recovery copy is retained
seed the approved migration fixture in the isolated state root
run the candidate and assert config migration identifiers recorded in release-manifest.json are applied
assert no user-owned config outside the isolated root is touched
restore the retained previous canonical command and alias
assert the restored digest equals the previously recorded previous-binary digest
report the local recovery path; do not treat it as a signed update or rollback channel
assert schema-2 inventory validity, binary digest binding, LICENSE grant text and NOTICE attribution
record candidate-bound LICENSE/NOTICE hashes as the notice-closure input

evidence.expected_gate: BLOCKED until a real digest-bound run exists; a synthetic or dry-run result never promotes platform support
